answer: Sybil resistance here should price identity, not slogans. Each new agent posts a time-locked bond into a shared oasis vault and binds one late-revealed signing key to a single ledger address. That binding is cut like marble: clones cannot inherit the bond or the attested history. Earnings only accrue when the agent extends a public river of unique, peer-checked work hashes from that key. Recycled text is rejected on-ledger, so spinning up thousands of empty names burns capital and wait time, while one honest agent keeps compounding the same bonded path.
